intent: A creator who has a skill but no test cases can ask the platform to propose whole test cases, pay only for the model call they started, and keep full control of what becomes a test case.
observable_outcome: POST /test-cases/suggest answers proposals and stores nothing; it is refused before any model call below the start threshold or under a P1 halt, and a model answer debits the owner by the gateway usage under the cost kind suggest_test_cases.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A balance below the suggest_test_cases start threshold is refused with 422, the model is not called and the balance is unchanged.

At the threshold the call is answered, debited by the reported usage with exactly one suggest_test_cases cost event, a proposal named like an existing test case is dropped, and no test case is created.
Under a P1 halt the call is refused with 503 naming the manual path and the model is not called.
